Selective: it reacts mostly at the onset of a flagged episode; no self-kept vol scale, snapshot gate, cross-market confirmation or crowd timing selects the onsets; the recorded Coinbase ticker adds a small replicated out-of-sample gain (+0.014 / +0.016 AUC; strong Binance ticks are taken more when Coinbase has not yet moved). strategy_statement: One operator runs a TypeScript clob-client bot on three (plus a fourth and a fifth) wallets in every BTC 5-minute Up/Down window, and only there [VALIDATE-only]. It pre-signs BUY orders on both outcomes at every cent in bursts each window (three bursts at -89.5 / +42 / +173 s since 08-22) [VALIDATE-only]. It submits one at the ask it saw ~30 ms before arriving (93% within a tick of the archive ask at the arrival on VALIDATE weekdays) [VALIDATE-only]. Polymarket holds every marketable order 150 ms, so the bot races the crowd in that delay queue [VALIDATE-only]. Which flagged episodes it takes is not decoded beyond small gains; the take rate follows an operator-level state with a 30-60-s time scale, and the independent fast crowd takes the same onsets on an input the recorded feeds explain only 14-21% of [VALIDATE-only; open]. The side is the direction of the fast venues' microprice over the last ~100-250 ms (live 83% where the six-series vote fires; on VALIDATE weekdays at the historical decision clock 77% of taker orders at full coverage, 81-83% in the first two minutes and 62-72% after three; 76.7% per one-sided block second) [VALIDATE-only]. Lost races rest at the old ask for ~0.1-1 s and fill as maker about half the time [VALIDATE-only]. The inventory is two operator-level streams: a large-size lean fanned out to every wallet and pyramided, and a small-size taker counter-flow that buys the complement of the REALIZED large inventory within ~2 minutes (own-state feedback, t -26) [VALIDATE-only]. Public data predicts the window net at r ~0.48 (the lean at ~0.32), and an executable exposure tracker reproduces the pooled per-window PnL at r 0.4758 / 0.4404 under strict fills with >= 2 s latency (per wallet 0.06-0.43; XM is bounded at 0.30-0.41 even by perfect pooled-stream oracles, because its PnL is the side of its own dispatched legs) [VALIDATE-only]. Positions are held to resolution; 87% of shares end in complete sets bought at 0.979; income = locked sets (~2.1 c per pair) and the 50% taker-fee rebate; the lean is a coin with respect to the outcome and carries the per-window PnL variance [VALIDATE-only]. Nothing is exam-verified.
